items.prompt: Leadership wants a first-pass cost model before any production EC2 is launched. Which approach best supports early architecture decisions?
items.expected: Estimate usage with the Pricing Calculator, then revisit after tagging and Cost Explorer baselines exist
items.picked: Estimate usage with the Pricing Calculator, then revisit after tagging and Cost Explorer baselines exist

items.prompt: An API tier needs horizontal scale based on CPU and must replace unhealthy instances automatically. Which combination fits?
items.expected: An Auto Scaling group with ELB health checks and a launch template
items.picked: An Auto Scaling group with ELB health checks and a launch template

items.prompt: App instances in private subnets must pull patches from the internet without accepting inbound internet connections. Which pattern is standard?
items.expected: NAT gateway in a public subnet with a default route from private subnets to the NAT
items.picked: NAT gateway in a public subnet with a default route from private subnets to the NAT

items.prompt: A new AWS organization must keep daily administration off the root user while still allowing break-glass recovery. Which baseline is most appropriate?
items.expected: Enable root MFA, store root credentials offline, and use IAM Identity Center or IAM roles for daily work
items.picked: Enable root MFA, store root credentials offline, and use IAM Identity Center or IAM roles for daily work

items.prompt: A stateful web tier must remain available if an Availability Zone fails. Which design meets this?
items.expected: Deploy instances across at least two AZs behind an Elastic Load Balancer
items.picked: Deploy instances across at least two AZs behind an Elastic Load Balancer
